checks: Configured compiler 3.13.0 uses Java21,-Xlint:all,-Werror; Surefire3.2.5 has failIfNoTests=true.
Existing tests cover audit output/stale refresh, recipe-only header/anchor edits, fixed points and scaffold cases when executed.
notes: This command runs the fixed crate's tests; it does not validate every recipe or prove arbitrary target behavior.

checks: Counts metadata/header/anchors and selected literal positions.
Generates or refreshes RECIPE_PERFECTION.tsv; report is unchanged when current.
notes: The current audit recognizes direct extends Recipe/ScanningRecipe declarations; metadata flags mean method presence, and its header predicate accepts either an SPDX marker or Copyright text. These are not complete contract/header checks.
Audit findings are static candidate evidence; they do not prove behavior, complete copyright metadata, tests or refusal.
The report itself is a generated/updated output; this recipe is not a no-write diagnostic.
Maven recipe discovery for this class has not been executed in this pass.

checks: Adds existing SPDX header when the implementation detects no header and adds missing FLLDCIM recipe anchor.
Non-recipe sources are unchanged; existing tests assert a fixed point.
notes: Does not repair arbitrary recipe semantics or arbitrary test/Main headers.
Does not claim to fill every incomplete header when an existing license/copyright marker already satisfies its header predicate.
Maven invocation is conditional on the class being visible to the plugin; not executed here.

checks: Generates a template test for metadata/validate and unchanged unrelated input.
Reports constructors/options it cannot infer in RECIPE_TEST_SCAFFOLD.tsv.
notes: Requires no-arg constructibility; it does not guess options such as crateName.
Scaffold presence and unrelated-input no-op do not prove positive transformation behavior or exact drift refusal.

checks: The actual descriptor defines HeaderAndAnchor -> Audit -> TestScaffold.
notes: README's two-owner description is older than the three-owner descriptor.
YAML discovery/activation and the composed Maven dry run are not proved by the earlier five direct bootstrap method proofs.

checks: Reuses the same existing strict compiler and test gate after a reviewed recipe implementation changes.
notes: Changed recipe/source/resource bytes require fresh evidence and preimage pins.
Passing implementation tests still leaves target application, external contracts, behavior and full repository gates separate.

checks: Runs HeaderAndAnchor, audit before/after, and a second HeaderAndAnchor pass per listed source.
notes: Hardcodes only HeaderAndAnchor transformation; does not execute the entire three-owner YAML composition.
Failures become rows; exit 0 alone does not prove success or zero fixed_point_changes.
Caller must prove list/root containment, bounded batch size, correct parser attribution and safe output routing; this CLI does not supply those general controls.

checks: Existing per-pass compiler/behavior/contract-root checks and per-stage fixed-point/oscillation accounting.
Bounded default profile is eight fixtures, not the full 67 fixtures through two feature axes.
notes: The CLI's canonical candidate set is not an arbitrary JSON recipe loader or an invocation of our bootstrap snapshot owner.
No broad correctness or universal equivalence follows from a bounded fixture search.
